title: 3-Step Bow
description: Adds a traffic-light color indicator (Green/Yellow/Red) to bows and crossbows to show their charge level. Never miss a full-power shot again!
body:
# 🎯 3-Step Bow
3-Step Bow is a lightweight, clean resource pack designed to give you instant visual feedback while using ranged weapons. It changes the texture of both Bows and Crossbows as you pull them back, helping you track your charge level perfectly during intense PvP fights or casual survival gameplay.

## ✨ Features
- Visual Drawback Stages: Ranged weapons shift colors through Green, Yellow, and Red based on how far they are drawn.

- Full Support: Works seamlessly on both Bows and Crossbows (including firework loading!).

- PvP Advantage: Know the exact moment your weapon is fully charged without losing focus on your target.

- Vanilla Friendly: Keeps the classic look of Minecraft while adding highly functional UI colors.
